Class SetupState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Controller.states.SetupState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameState
public class SetupState extends Object implements GameState
State active during GamePhase.SETUP. The game is being initialized. No player actions are accepted..
